status.note: DeepInfra's blog lists no acquisition of the company; its latest company announcement is the May 2026 Series B.

retention.value: Not stored; held in memory only during inference
retention.quote: When using DeepInfra inference APIs, we do not store the data you submit to our APIs on disk.
retention.note: The same page says image generation outputs are stored for a short period, bulk inference data may be stored on disk for a short retention period, and Google and Anthropic models store outputs under those companies' own terms.

zdr.quote: Provider will not retain, store, or log any Customer Data submitted to or generated by the Services beyond the period strictly necessary to process and return the applicable request, after which such Customer Data is deleted from Provider's systems in the ordinary course of operations ("Zero Data Retention").
zdr.note: The terms list exceptions, including data kept at the customer's written request for support, records kept for legal, fraud, security or abuse reasons, and features the customer elects to use such as batch requests.

zdr_how.value: Nothing to turn on; applies to models hosted by DeepInfra, not to third-party models
zdr_how.quote: Zero Data Retention applies to models hosted by Provider; Customer Data that Customer elects to submit to a third-party model made available through the Services is governed by Section 18 and the applicable third party's terms.

training.quote: We do not use data you submit to our APIs for training models, except when using Google or Anthropic models, where the receiving company’s training policy applies.
training.note: For Google and Anthropic models offered through DeepInfra, the receiving company's training policy applies.

soc2.quote: DeepInfra is SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified.
soc2.note: No public DeepInfra page read says whether the report is Type I or Type II; the trust centre lists SOC 2 as Compliant.

attestations.quote: DeepInfra is SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified.
attestations.note: The trust centre FAQ (https://trust.deepinfra.com/faq) says "DeepInfra signs a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) with customers on an enterprise agreement", for models hosted by DeepInfra only; the trust centre lists GDPR as In progress.

regions.quote: All DeepInfra inference runs in data centers in the United States.
regions.note: The sentence is in a collapsed FAQ answer on that page.
